visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a green tactical-style jacket stands in a sunlit forest. He holds a black and camo-patterned SHOEI helmet, pointing to a dark grey SENA 60S communication device attached to its side. (2) The scene cuts to the helmet resting on a small outdoor table; the camera pans closely around the device. (3) An aerial drone shot reveals a large group of motorcyclists gathered in a wide, rocky riverbed canyon with green mountains in the distance. (4) Back to the man, he demonstrates the device's features, gesturing with his hands towards the helmet's surface. (5) A close-up shows the SENA 60S unit with 'Sound by harman/kardon' text clearly visible. (6) Several interchangeable rings and faceplates (white, black, grey) are displayed on a wooden surface. (7) A hand peels a green protective film off a DIY painted plate and attaches it to the device on the helmet. (8) A macro shot shows the interior of the helmet, focusing on the mesh padding and the 'harman/kardon' logo on the speaker. (9) The man detaches the main unit from the magnetic mount and shows it to the camera before snapping it back. (10) He concludes by giving a thumbs-up while holding the helmet in the forest setting.
